verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents its own automatic handling of unsubscribes, complaints, and bounces, plus a 'Bounce Tracking' feature to 'identify and manage bounced emails'. That covers the core goal of never re-emailing a hard bounce. However, no evidence shows API endpoints for reading, adding, or deleting entries on the bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe suppression lists. The management surface could just as well be the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented suppression-list API endpoints (list/get/add/delete) for bounces, complaints, and unsubscribes; evidence that complaint and unsubscribe lists can be managed programmatically; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce
